blockers.message: Requires an approved value for fixed_schedule_interval_choice (the fixed-schedule comparator interval).
Requires an approved value for hrv_trigger_assumed_accuracy (the swept trigger-accuracy values).
Requires an approved value for decision_tier_thresholds (the probability-to-tier thresholds the metrics key off of).

No approved rule exists for translating an assumed trigger accuracy (e.g. 0.7) into which days a synthetic trigger actually fires. This is a simulation-design choice, not a parameter-sheet value, and needs explicit human sign-off before any sweep point can be executed.
